annotations.title: Watch a search for new results

description: Save a search of jobs, companies or people, or a feed of company events, and come back for what is new: kind is jobs, companies, people or events, filters are the arguments of search_jobs, search_companies, search_people or search_company_events (e.g. {"role":"Backend","country":"DE","work_mode":"remote"}). Answers the first page now (newest first, compact) and a watch_id; check_watch with it later returns only the rows that appeared since. Up to 20 watches per agent (an account, a wallet, or a network and client name). Use it for a job hunt, a hiring pipeline or a market you follow. Free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

deliver.description: "webhook" posts what is new to the agent's webhook (set_webhook; an account's agent) every 15 minutes as "watch.jobs", "watch.companies" or "watch.events" - free, but the events of a whole slice at $0.005 each; "poll"...

filters.description: The search arguments to follow (cursor and limit are ignored).

kind.description: What to watch: jobs, companies, people, or events (the company event feed of search_company_events: funding rounds, new offices, leadership hires, Buying windows...

name.description: A short label, e.g. "Remote Go roles in EU".

name: watch_search
